# Aaron Garments storefront

- Project: responsive React + TypeScript storefront built with Vite.
- Run locally with `npm run dev`; validate a production build with `npm run build`.
- Product and cart data are mock client-side data in `src/App.tsx`. Checkout and newsletter forms are demos; no real orders or emails are submitted.
- Keep the original Aaron Garments branding and maintain responsive, keyboard-accessible shopping controls.
- Product photography is loaded from Unsplash; replace with licensed brand photography before production.
